place: Choeng Mon, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320, Thailand
title: Five-Bedroom Sea-View Entertainment Villa in Choeng Mon with Private Cinema
blurb: A design-led hillside villa built for entertaining — two living rooms, a private cinema, bar and games room, five sea-view master suites and a pool terrace facing the Gulf of Thailand, minutes from Choeng Mon beach. Fully solar-powered and already a proven rental performer.
detail:
Set on a private green hillside just off the Choeng Mon beach road, this villa looks straight out over the Gulf of Thailand with nothing in the way. Choeng Mon beach is about five minutes away, and Bang Rak and Chaweng are only a short drive further, so the house feels secluded without being remote.

The house is laid out for gathering people together. The main living space is one large, open room — lounge, dining table for ten and a striking kitchen with a long marble island and bar seating — wrapped in glass and opening onto the pool terrace. A second living room leads into a dedicated cinema with a large screen and deep sofas, and there is a private bar and games room for evenings that run late.

Outside, a turquoise pool is framed by tropical planting and loungers, with a covered terrace above for long lunches and a second terrace higher up for sunset. The interiors are a confident mix of dark marble, slatted timber, warm wooden floors and soft grey textiles — polished, comfortable and ready to use from day one.

All five bedrooms are master suites with sea views and their own bathrooms, finished with freestanding stone basins and walk-in showers; there are seven bathrooms in total. Practicalities are well covered: a 50 kVA solar installation with battery storage, water storage tanks and CCTV.

The villa already rents well at high nightly rates, which makes it equally convincing as a family home or as an income-producing investment. Around 672 m² of interior space and roughly 1,020 m² of total living area including terraces, offered freehold.
